rule: Cashier screens reachable in one tap from order entry (tender, table map, search)
Illustrations only in empty states and onboarding; none on operational screens
Gloved and wet-hand operation: no pressure or multi-touch gestures required
Audio cues paired with visual cues and can be muted
Role-based navigation: items the role cannot use are hidden, not disabled
Colour is never the only carrier of meaning; pair with icon, text or pattern
anti_pattern: KDS age shown by colour alone

rule: Dark theme text 7:1 on operational dark surfaces (KDS)
New KDS ticket announces with a single chime plus a brief highlight
Order-age colour: green under 5 min, amber under 10, red from 10, plus icon and timer text
Bump bar keys 1 to 9 bump slot, R recall, S station; legend on screen
Table map tiles show number large, covers and minutes small, colour by state with icon
Dark theme for KDS with 7:1 text; light for cashier
Kitchen tickets: item names 2x size, modifiers indented, seat and course tags
KDS ticket appears within 1 s of firing over websocket
KDS shows 4 to 6 tickets per row on a 15-inch screen; never fewer than 3
Order numbers and table numbers in the largest weight on their screens
Kitchen screens use 20 px minimum with high x-height fonts
Kitchen ticket header shows table, covers, server, time in 2x font
